plan.calibration: Sigmoid candidates: reserve last20 mature dates, purge earlier fit before first calibration feature date; no post-calibration base refit. None candidates: fit all mature training dates.
plan.deployment_selection: best development candidate, including prior if it wins; final metrics never choose model
plan.final_data_status: Dates were previously inspected for regression research and V1 classification. V2 corrects unused calibration reservation for none candidates; all choices still use development Brier only. Repeated historical reference, not a pristine unseen-market holdout.
plan.selection_metric: equal-date Brier; ties log loss; compare entity-shrunk training frequency
plan.sentiment_gate: >=30 distinct mature labeled dates with PIT-scored news; otherwise freeze six news features to missing, never inject today into the past
plan.target: target day close > / < / = previous trading day close; classify up conditional on nonflat, empirical flat rate
plan.uncertainty: paired 5-day moving-block bootstrap over entire dates; never treat 31 same-day sectors as independent market days
plan.validation: 3 consecutive 15-date development blocks, then one predeclared final20 historical dates
